|game_text=Deploy on table. [[A Jedi's Resilience]] may not be played during move phases. [[The Circle Is Now Complete]] or [[Vader's Obsession]] may be played during any move phase to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Vader present with specified target, each player draws two destiny (if armed with a lightsaber, each destiny is +1); add ability. |errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-41-Epic_Duel.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: '''this page''' (original, release sheet of 4 September 2009); [[Epic Duel (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Epic Duel (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Epic Duel (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Deploy on table. A Jedi's Resilience may not be played during move phases. The Circle Is Now Complete or Vader's Obsession may be played during any move phase to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Vader present with specified target, each player draws two destiny (if armed with a lightsaber, each destiny is +1); add ability. Loser (lower total) is lost, losing player loses 2 Force, and winning player may retrieve 2 Force.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Epic Duel (V) (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=34, page 34. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=34 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “41” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Epic Duel (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “(lower total)” to “(lowest total)”: “Deploy on table. A Jedi's Resilience may not be played during move phases. The Circle Is Now Complete or Vader's Obsession may be played during any move phase to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Vader present with specified target, each player draws two destiny (if armed with a lightsaber, each destiny is +1); add ability. Loser (lowest total) is lost, losing player loses 2 Force, and winning player may retrieve 2 Force.”.<ref name="cl-1261_39-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Epic Duel (V) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-epicduel-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “Deploy on table. A Jedi's Resilience may not be played during move phases. The Circle Is Now Complete or Vader's Obsession may be played during any move phase to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Vader present with specified target, each player draws two destiny (if armed with a lightsaber, each destiny is +1); add ability. Loser (lower total) is lost, losing player loses 2 Force, and winning player may retrieve 2 Force.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual6-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual6-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034706/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “41” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Epic Duel (V) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 34)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “Deploy on table. A Jedi's Resilience may not be played during move phases. The Circle Is Now Complete or Vader's Obsession may be played during any move phase to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Vader present with specified target, each player draws two destiny (if armed with a lightsaber, each destiny is +1); add ability. Loser (lower total) is lost, losing player loses 2 Force, and winning player may retrieve 2 Force.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-39-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “41”).
